CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION dation_private.activity_kind(kind text, meta jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE kind WHEN 'team.invited' THEN 'member.invited' WHEN 'team.invitation_accepted' THEN 'member.joined'
 WHEN 'team.invitation_revoked' THEN 'member.invitation_revoked' WHEN 'team.member_updated' THEN
 CASE WHEN meta->'after'->>'status'='disabled' AND meta->'before'->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'disabled' THEN 'member.disabled'
 WHEN meta->'after'->>'status'='active' AND meta->'before'->>'status'='disabled' THEN 'member.enabled'
 WHEN meta->'after'->>'access_role' IS DISTINCT FROM meta->'before'->>'access_role' THEN 'member.role_changed'
 ELSE 'member.updated' END ELSE kind END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION dation_private.case_collaboration(wid uuid, cid uuid, uid uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(n.node_id,jsonb_build_object('owner',dation_private.team_person(wid,a.owner_user_id),
  'approver',dation_private.team_person(wid,a.owner_user_id),'updated_at',a.updated_at,'can_execute',dation_private.responsibility_eligible(wid,a.owner_user_id,'decision_owner') AND (m.access_role='admin' OR m.access_role='operator' AND a.owner_user_id=uid),
  'can_approve',dation_private.responsibility_eligible(wid,a.owner_user_id,'decision_owner') AND (m.access_role='admin' OR m.access_role='operator' AND a.owner_user_id=uid),
  'admin_override',m.access_role='admin' AND a.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL AND a.owner_user_id<>uid)), '{}')
 FROM (VALUES('logistics_assignment'),('logistics_scheduling'),('logistics_final_assignment')) n(node_id)
 JOIN workspace_members m ON m.workspace_id=wid AND m.user_id=uid AND m.status='active'
 LEFT JOIN decision_assignments a ON a.workspace_id=wid AND a.decision_case_id=cid AND a.node_id=n.node_id;
$function$

 WITH latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON(r.decision_case_id,r.node_id) r.decision_case_id,r.node_id,r.id,r.status,r.upstream_run_id,r.approved_at,r.superseded_at
  FROM decision_runs r WHERE r.workspace_id=wid AND r.node_id IN('logistics_assignment','logistics_scheduling')
  ORDER BY r.decision_case_id,r.node_id,r.created_at DESC,r.id DESC
 ), approved AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT r.decision_case_id,r.node_id,r.id,r.upstream_run_id FROM decision_runs r
  WHERE r.workspace_id=wid AND r.node_id IN('logistics_assignment','logistics_scheduling') AND r.approved_at IS NOT NULL AND r.superseded_at IS NULL
 ), nodes AS (
  SELECT c.id,
   l.id IS NOT NULL AND l.approved_at IS NULL AND l.superseded_at IS NULL AS candidate,
   l.status, a.id IS NOT NULL AND (n.node_id='logistics_assignment' OR a.upstream_run_id=source.id) AS current_approval,
   l.id IS NOT NULL AND l.approved_at IS NULL AND l.superseded_at IS NULL AND l.status='completed'
    AND (n.node_id='logistics_assignment' OR l.upstream_run_id=source.id) AS reviewing,
   dation_private.responsibility_eligible(wid,assignment.owner_user_id,'decision_owner') AND (member_role='admin' OR (member_role='operator' AND (assignment.owner_user_id IS NULL OR assignment.owner_user_id=uid)))
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workspace_ddas d WHERE d.workspace_id=wid AND d.dda_id=c.domain AND d.status='enabled') AS can_approve
  FROM decision_cases c CROSS JOIN (VALUES('logistics_assignment'),('logistics_scheduling')) n(node_id)
  LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.decision_case_id=c.id AND l.node_id=n.node_id
  LEFT JOIN approved a ON a.decision_case_id=c.id AND a.node_id=n.node_id
  LEFT JOIN approved source ON source.decision_case_id=c.id AND source.node_id='logistics_assignment'
  LEFT JOIN decision_assignments assignment ON assignment.workspace_id=wid AND assignment.decision_case_id=c.id AND assignment.node_id=n.node_id
  WHERE c.workspace_id=wid AND c.domain='logistics'
 ), counts AS (
  SELECT id,count(*) FILTER(WHERE reviewing) reviews,count(*) FILTER(WHERE reviewing AND can_approve) pending,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE current_approval) approvals,count(*) FILTER(WHERE candidate AND status IN('queued','running')) running,
   bool_or(candidate) unfinished FROM nodes GROUP BY id
 )
 SELECT c.id,CASE WHEN c.status='archived' THEN 'archived'
  WHEN c.domain='logistics' AND counts.approvals=2 AND NOT counts.unfinished THEN 'completed'
  WHEN c.domain='logistics' THEN 'active' ELSE c.status END,
  coalesce(counts.reviews,0),coalesce(counts.pending,0),coalesce(counts.approvals,0),coalesce(counts.running,0)
 FROM decision_cases c LEFT JOIN counts ON counts.id=c.id WHERE c.workspace_id=wid
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION dation_private.list_decision_cases(case_status text DEFAULT 'active'::text, page_limit integer DEFAULT 50, page_offset integer DEFAULT 0, summary_only boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS TABLE(case_row jsonb, orders jsonb, fleet jsonb, summaries jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'dation_private', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF case_status IS NOT NULL AND case_status NOT IN ('active','completed','archived')
    OR page_limit IS NULL OR page_limit < 1 OR page_limit > 100
    OR page_offset IS NULL OR page_offset < 0 OR summary_only IS NULL THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='Paginación de casos inválida';
 END IF;
 RETURN QUERY
 WITH page AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT c.* FROM public.decision_cases c
   WHERE c.workspace_id=dation_private.workspace_id() AND (case_status IS NULL OR c.status=case_status)
   ORDER BY c.last_activity_at DESC,c.id DESC LIMIT page_limit OFFSET page_offset
 ), nodes(node_id) AS (VALUES
   ('logistics_assignment'::text),('logistics_scheduling'),('logistics_final_assignment'))
 SELECT to_jsonb(c),
   CASE WHEN summary_only THEN jsonb_build_object(
     'id',o.id,'dataset_type',o.dataset_type,'canonical_filename',o.canonical_filename,
     'label',o.label,'original_filename',o.original_filename)
     ELSE to_jsonb(o) END,
   CASE WHEN summary_only THEN jsonb_build_object(
     'id',f.id,'dataset_type',f.dataset_type,'canonical_filename',f.canonical_filename,
     'label',f.label,'original_filename',f.original_filename)
     ELSE to_jsonb(f) END,
   (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(n.node_id,jsonb_build_object(
     'run_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.decision_runs r
       WHERE r.decision_case_id=c.id AND r.node_id=n.node_id),
     'latest',(SELECT to_jsonb(compact) FROM (
       SELECT r.id,r.node_id,r.upstream_run_id,r.status,r.error_message,
              r.approved_at,r.superseded_at
       FROM public.decision_runs r WHERE r.decision_case_id=c.id AND r.node_id=n.node_id
       ORDER BY r.created_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT 1) compact),
     'approved',(SELECT to_jsonb(compact) FROM (
       SELECT r.id,r.node_id,r.upstream_run_id,r.status,r.error_message,
              r.approved_at,r.superseded_at
       FROM public.decision_runs r WHERE r.decision_case_id=c.id AND r.node_id=n.node_id
       AND r.approved_at IS NOT NULL AND r.superseded_at IS NULL LIMIT 1) compact)
   )) FROM nodes n)
 FROM page c JOIN public.datasets o ON o.id=c.orders_dataset_id
             JOIN public.datasets f ON f.id=c.fleet_dataset_id
 ORDER BY c.last_activity_at DESC,c.id DESC;
END;
$function$

 IF NOT FOUND OR (admin_only AND role_name<>'admin') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Team access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN role_name;

 RETURNS SETOF decision_comparative_analyses
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'dation_private', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE target uuid;
BEGIN
 UPDATE decision_comparative_analyses SET status='error',lease_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,finished_at=clock_timestamp(),
  error_message='El análisis agotó su plazo o sus intentos de recuperación.',progress_json='{"stage":"error","reason":"recovery_exhausted"}'
 WHERE status IN('queued','running') AND (deadline_at<=clock_timestamp() OR
  (status='running' AND lease_expires_at<=clock_timestamp() AND attempts>=max_attempts));
 SELECT id INTO target FROM decision_comparative_analyses WHERE
  ((status='queued' AND available_at<=clock_timestamp()) OR (status='running' AND lease_expires_at<=clock_timestamp()))
  AND attempts<max_attempts AND deadline_at>clock_timestamp()
 ORDER BY available_at,created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN; END IF;
 UPDATE decision_comparative_analyses SET status='running',attempts=attempts+1,lease_token=worker_token,
  heartbeat_at=clock_timestamp(),started_at=coalesce(started_at,clock_timestamp()),
  lease_expires_at=least(deadline_at,clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>greatest(30,least(lease_seconds,300)))),
  progress_json=jsonb_build_object('stage','validating','attempt',attempts+1)
 WHERE id=target;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM decision_comparative_analyses WHERE id=target;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.platform_activity(target_workspace_id uuid, actor_user_id uuid, target_case_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, page_limit integer DEFAULT 5, before_time timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, before_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE answer jsonb; logistics boolean;
BEGIN
 PERFORM dation_private.team_actor(target_workspace_id,actor_user_id);
 IF page_limit IS NULL OR page_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 50 OR (before_time IS NULL)<>(before_id IS NULL) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid activity query' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 IF target_case_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decision_cases WHERE workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND id=target_case_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Case not found' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workspace_ddas WHERE workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND dda_id='logistics' AND status='enabled') INTO logistics;
 WITH page AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.*,coalesce(e.decision_case_id,CASE WHEN e.metadata_json->>'case_id' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN (e.metadata_json->>'case_id')::uuid END) cid
  FROM audit_events e WHERE workspace_id=target_workspace_id
  AND (target_case_id IS NULL OR e.decision_case_id=target_case_id OR e.metadata_json->>'case_id'=target_case_id::text)
  AND (target_case_id IS NOT NULL OR logistics OR e.event_type LIKE 'workspace.%' OR e.event_type LIKE 'team.%' OR e.event_type LIKE 'member.%')
  AND (before_time IS NULL OR (e.created_at,e.id)<(before_time,before_id))
  ORDER BY e.created_at DESC,e.id DESC LIMIT page_limit+1),
 visible AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM page ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT page_limit)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('items',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'id',e.id,'event_type',dation_private.activity_kind(e.event_type,e.metadata_json),'object_type',coalesce(e.object_type,CASE WHEN e.event_type LIKE 'workspace.%' THEN 'workspace' WHEN e.metadata_json->>'run_id' IS NOT NULL THEN 'run' WHEN e.cid IS NOT NULL THEN 'decision_case' ELSE NULL END),
  'object_id',coalesce(e.object_id,CASE WHEN e.event_type LIKE 'workspace.%' THEN e.workspace_id WHEN e.metadata_json->>'run_id' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN (e.metadata_json->>'run_id')::uuid ELSE e.cid END),
  'is_demo',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM datasets d WHERE d.workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND d.is_sample AND ((e.object_type='dataset' AND d.id=e.object_id) OR d.id IN(SELECT c.orders_dataset_id FROM decision_cases c WHERE c.id=e.cid AND c.workspace_id=target_workspace_id UNION ALL SELECT c.fleet_dataset_id FROM decision_cases c WHERE c.id=e.cid AND c.workspace_id=target_workspace_id))),'case_id',e.cid,'node_id',coalesce(e.node_id,e.metadata_json->>'node_id'),'created_at',e.created_at,
  'actor',CASE WHEN e.actor_user_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE coalesce(dation_private.center_person(target_workspace_id,e.actor_user_id),jsonb_build_object('id',e.actor_user_id,'name','Usuario sin perfil disponible')) END,
  'metadata',jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('source',e.metadata_json->'source','automatic',e.metadata_json->'automatic',
   'dataset_type',e.metadata_json->'dataset_type','row_count',e.metadata_json->'row_count','valid',e.metadata_json->'valid',
   'format',e.metadata_json->'format','bytes',e.metadata_json->'bytes','sha256',e.metadata_json->'sha256',
   'admin_override',e.metadata_json->'admin_override','section',e.metadata_json->'section','stage_key',e.metadata_json->'stage_key','data_responsible_user_id',e.metadata_json->'data_responsible_user_id','decision_owner_user_id',e.metadata_json->'decision_owner_user_id','assigned_approver_user_id',e.metadata_json->'assigned_approver_user_id','data_assignment_updated_at',e.metadata_json->'data_assignment_updated_at','decision_assignment_updated_at',e.metadata_json->'decision_assignment_updated_at','previous_user_id',e.metadata_json->'previous_user_id','new_user_id',e.metadata_json->'new_user_id',
   'access_role',coalesce(e.metadata_json->'access_role',e.metadata_json->'after'->'access_role')))) ORDER BY e.created_at DESC,e.id DESC) FROM visible e),'[]'),
  'next_cursor',CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM page)>page_limit THEN
  (SELECT jsonb_build_object('before_time',created_at,'before_id',id) FROM visible ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 1) ELSE NULL END)
 INTO answer;
 RETURN answer;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.platform_data_hub(target_workspace_id uuid, actor_user_id uuid, resource text DEFAULT 'datasets'::text, filter_name text DEFAULT 'all'::text, search_text text DEFAULT ''::text, target_dataset_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, orders_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, fleet_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, page_limit integer DEFAULT 25, page_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE answer jsonb; target datasets; role_name text; used boolean;
BEGIN
 role_name=dation_private.data_actor(target_workspace_id,actor_user_id);
 IF resource NOT IN('datasets','dataset','packs','pack') OR filter_name NOT IN('all','orders','fleet','validated','issues','archived')
 OR page_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 50 OR page_offset NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000 OR length(search_text)>120 THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid library query' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 IF resource IN('dataset','pack') THEN
  IF resource='dataset' THEN
   SELECT * INTO target FROM datasets WHERE workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND id=target_dataset_id;
   IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Dataset not found' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
   used=dation_private.dataset_referenced(target_workspace_id,target.id);
   SELECT jsonb_build_object('dataset',dation_private.hub_dataset(target),
    'validation_report',coalesce(target.profile_json-'preview','{}'),
    'used_in',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c)) FROM (SELECT id,status,created_at FROM decision_cases
     WHERE workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND (orders_dataset_id=target.id OR fleet_dataset_id=target.id)
     ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT page_limit OFFSET page_offset) c),'[]'),
    'can_archive',role_name<>'viewer' AND target.dataset_type IN('orders','fleet') AND NOT target.is_default AND target.deletion_requested_at IS NULL,
    'can_delete',role_name<>'viewer' AND target.archived_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT target.is_default AND NOT used,
    'referenced',used) INTO answer;
   RETURN answer;
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decision_cases WHERE workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND orders_dataset_id=orders_id AND fleet_dataset_id=fleet_id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Data Pack not found' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF resource='datasets' THEN
  WITH matched AS (SELECT d.* FROM datasets d WHERE d.workspace_id=target_workspace_id
   AND CASE WHEN filter_name='archived' THEN d.archived_at IS NOT NULL ELSE d.archived_at IS NULL END
   AND (filter_name NOT IN('orders','fleet') OR d.dataset_type=filter_name)
   AND (filter_name<>'validated' OR d.profile_json->'valid'='true')
   AND (filter_name<>'issues' OR d.profile_json->'valid'='false')
   AND (search_text='' OR strpos(lower(concat_ws(' ',d.original_filename,d.canonical_filename,d.label)),lower(search_text))>0)),
  page AS (SELECT * FROM matched ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT page_limit OFFSET page_offset)
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('items',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(dation_private.hub_dataset(p::public.datasets) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.id DESC) FROM page p),'[]'),
   'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM matched),'limit',page_limit,'offset',page_offset,
   'incomplete_uploads',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(u)) FROM
    (SELECT id,filename,created_at,status FROM dation_private.dataset_uploads u
     WHERE u.workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND (u.status IN('failed','discarding') OR (u.status='pending' AND u.created_at<now()-interval '15 minutes'))
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM datasets d WHERE d.id=u.dataset_id AND d.workspace_id=target_workspace_id)
     ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 10) u),'[]')) INTO answer;
  RETURN answer;
 END IF;
 -- A Data Pack is the immutable Orders/Fleet pair already used by cases.
 WITH pairs AS (SELECT c.orders_dataset_id,c.fleet_dataset_id,min(c.created_at) created_at,count(*) case_count
  FROM decision_cases c WHERE c.workspace_id=target_workspace_id GROUP BY c.orders_dataset_id,c.fleet_dataset_id),
 matched AS (SELECT p.*,dation_private.hub_dataset(o) orders,dation_private.hub_dataset(f) fleet,
  coalesce(nullif(o.label,''),o.canonical_filename,o.original_filename)||' + '||coalesce(nullif(f.label,''),f.canonical_filename,f.original_filename) label,
  o.profile_json->'valid'='true' AND f.profile_json->'valid'='true' validated
  FROM pairs p JOIN datasets o ON o.id=p.orders_dataset_id AND o.workspace_id=target_workspace_id
  JOIN datasets f ON f.id=p.fleet_dataset_id AND f.workspace_id=target_workspace_id
  WHERE (resource<>'pack' OR (p.orders_dataset_id=orders_id AND p.fleet_dataset_id=fleet_id))
  AND (search_text='' OR strpos(lower(concat_ws(' ',o.label,o.original_filename,o.canonical_filename,f.label,f.original_filename,f.canonical_filename)),lower(search_text))>0)),
 page AS (SELECT * FROM matched ORDER BY created_at DESC,orders_dataset_id,fleet_dataset_id
  LIMIT CASE WHEN resource='pack' THEN 1 ELSE page_limit END OFFSET CASE WHEN resource='pack' THEN 0 ELSE page_offset END)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('items',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.orders_dataset_id,p.fleet_dataset_id) FROM page p),'[]'),
  'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM matched),'limit',page_limit,'offset',page_offset) INTO answer;
 IF resource='pack' THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('pack',answer->'items'->0,'used_in',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c)) FROM
   (SELECT id,status,created_at FROM decision_cases WHERE workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND orders_dataset_id=orders_id AND fleet_dataset_id=fleet_id
    ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT page_limit OFFSET page_offset) c),'[]'));
 END IF;
 RETURN answer;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.platform_dataset_library(target_workspace_id uuid, actor_user_id uuid, target_dataset_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, dataset_type text DEFAULT 'all'::text, validation_state text DEFAULT 'all'::text, lifecycle_state text DEFAULT 'active'::text, search_text text DEFAULT ''::text, page_limit integer DEFAULT 25, page_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE answer jsonb; target datasets;
BEGIN
 PERFORM dation_private.data_actor(target_workspace_id,actor_user_id);
 IF dataset_type NOT IN('all','orders','fleet','logistics_legacy') OR validation_state NOT IN('all','validated','issues','unknown')
 OR lifecycle_state NOT IN('all','active','archived') OR length(search_text)>120
 OR page_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 50 OR page_offset NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000 THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid dataset library query' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 IF target_dataset_id IS NOT NULL THEN
  -- Keep the existing bounded validation report and conservative lifecycle permits.
  answer=public.platform_data_hub(target_workspace_id,actor_user_id,resource=>'dataset',
   target_dataset_id=>target_dataset_id,page_limit=>page_limit,page_offset=>page_offset);
  SELECT * INTO target FROM datasets WHERE workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND id=target_dataset_id;
  RETURN answer||jsonb_build_object('dataset',dation_private.library_dataset(target),
   'case_total',(SELECT count(*) FROM dation_private.dataset_case_usage(target_workspace_id,target_dataset_id)),
   'used_in',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.id DESC) FROM
    (SELECT c.id,c.status,c.created_at,c.label,c.domain AS dda,'DC-'||upper(left(c.id::text,8)) AS friendly_id
     FROM dation_private.dataset_case_usage(target_workspace_id,target_dataset_id) c
     ORDER BY c.created_at DESC,c.id DESC LIMIT page_limit OFFSET page_offset) p),'[]'));
 END IF;
 WITH workspace AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM datasets WHERE workspace_id=target_workspace_id),
 matched AS (SELECT * FROM workspace d WHERE
  (platform_dataset_library.dataset_type='all' OR d.dataset_type=platform_dataset_library.dataset_type)
  AND (lifecycle_state='all' OR (lifecycle_state='active' AND d.archived_at IS NULL) OR (lifecycle_state='archived' AND d.archived_at IS NOT NULL))
  AND (validation_state='all' OR CASE WHEN d.profile_json->'valid'='true' THEN 'validated' WHEN d.profile_json->'valid'='false' THEN 'issues' ELSE 'unknown' END=validation_state)
  AND (search_text='' OR strpos(lower(concat_ws(' ',d.label,d.canonical_filename,d.original_filename)),lower(search_text))>0)),
 page AS (SELECT * FROM matched ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT page_limit OFFSET page_offset)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('items',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(dation_private.library_dataset(p::public.datasets) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.id DESC) FROM page p),'[]'),
  'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM matched),'limit',page_limit,'offset',page_offset,
  'summary',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('total',count(*),'validated',count(*) FILTER(WHERE profile_json->'valid'='true'),
   'issues',count(*) FILTER(WHERE profile_json->'valid'='false'),'archived',count(*) FILTER(WHERE archived_at IS NOT NULL)) FROM workspace),
  'incomplete_uploads',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(u) ORDER BY u.created_at DESC,u.id DESC) FROM
   (SELECT id,filename,created_at,status FROM dation_private.dataset_uploads u WHERE u.workspace_id=target_workspace_id
    AND (u.status IN('failed','discarding') OR (u.status='pending' AND u.created_at<now()-interval '15 minutes'))
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM datasets d WHERE d.workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND d.id=u.dataset_id)
    ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 10) u),'[]')) INTO answer;
 RETURN answer;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.platform_decision_portfolio(target_workspace_id uuid, actor_user_id uuid, target_case_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, filter_name text DEFAULT 'all'::text, search_text text DEFAULT ''::text, dda text DEFAULT 'all'::text, target_node_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, page_limit integer DEFAULT 25, page_offset integer DEFAULT 0, owner_filter text DEFAULT 'all'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE member_role text; answer jsonb; selected_owner uuid;
BEGIN
 member_role=dation_private.data_actor(target_workspace_id,actor_user_id);
 PERFORM set_config('dation.workspace_id',target_workspace_id::text,true);
 IF filter_name NOT IN('all','in_progress','review','pending_approval','approved','completed','archived')
 OR dda IS NULL OR length(dda)>48 OR dda!~'^[a-z0-9_-]+$' OR length(search_text)>120
 OR page_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 50 OR page_offset NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000 OR owner_filter IS NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid portfolio query' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 IF owner_filter NOT IN('all','me','unassigned') THEN
  BEGIN selected_owner=owner_filter::uuid; EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid owner filter' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END;
 ELSIF owner_filter='me' THEN selected_owner=actor_user_id; END IF;
 IF target_case_id IS NOT NULL THEN
  answer=public.platform_decision_center(target_workspace_id,actor_user_id,target_case_id,'all',CASE WHEN target_node_id IS NOT NULL THEN search_text ELSE '' END,'all',target_node_id,page_limit,page_offset);
  IF target_node_id IS NULL THEN
   answer=answer||jsonb_build_object('responsibilities',public.platform_workflow_responsibilities(target_workspace_id,actor_user_id,target_case_id));
  END IF;
  RETURN answer;
 END IF;
 WITH facts AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT * FROM dation_private.center_portfolio_facts(target_workspace_id,actor_user_id,member_role)),
 base AS(SELECT c.*,f.life,f.review_count,f.pending_count,f.approved_count,f.running_count FROM decision_cases c JOIN facts f ON f.case_id=c.id
  WHERE c.workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND (dda='all' OR c.domain=dda)
   AND (search_text='' OR strpos(lower(concat_ws(' ',c.id::text,'DC-'||substr(c.id::text,1,8),c.label)),lower(search_text))>0)
   AND (owner_filter='all' OR
    (owner_filter='unassigned' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decision_assignments a WHERE a.workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND a.decision_case_id=c.id AND a.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL)
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dation_private.workflow_stage_assignments a WHERE a.workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND a.decision_case_id=c.id AND a.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL)) OR
    (selected_owner IS NOT NULL AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decision_assignments a WHERE a.workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND a.decision_case_id=c.id AND a.owner_user_id=selected_owner)
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dation_private.workflow_stage_assignments a WHERE a.workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND a.decision_case_id=c.id AND a.owner_user_id=selected_owner))))),
 matched AS(SELECT * FROM base WHERE CASE filter_name WHEN 'archived' THEN life='archived' WHEN 'completed' THEN life='completed'
  WHEN 'in_progress' THEN life='active' WHEN 'review' THEN life<>'archived' AND review_count>0
  WHEN 'pending_approval' THEN life<>'archived' AND pending_count>0 WHEN 'approved' THEN life<>'archived' AND approved_count>0 ELSE life<>'archived' END),
 page AS(SELECT * FROM matched ORDER BY last_activity_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT page_limit OFFSET page_offset),
 owners AS(SELECT owner_user_id id FROM decision_assignments WHERE workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
  UNION SELECT owner_user_id FROM dation_private.workflow_stage_assignments WHERE workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND owner_user_id IS NOT NULL)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('summary',jsonb_build_object(
  'active_cases',(SELECT count(*) FROM facts WHERE life='active'),
  'in_review',(SELECT coalesce(sum(review_count),0) FROM facts WHERE life<>'archived'),
  'pending_approval',(SELECT coalesce(sum(pending_count),0) FROM facts WHERE life<>'archived'),
  'approved',(SELECT coalesce(sum(approved_count),0) FROM facts WHERE life<>'archived')),
  'items',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg((dation_private.center_bundle(c)||jsonb_build_object(
   'collaboration',dation_private.case_collaboration(target_workspace_id,p.id,actor_user_id),
   'portfolio_facts',jsonb_build_object('review',p.review_count,'pending',p.pending_count,'approved',p.approved_count,'running',p.running_count))) ORDER BY p.last_activity_at DESC,p.id DESC)
   FROM decision_cases c JOIN page p ON p.id=c.id WHERE c.workspace_id=target_workspace_id),'[]'),
  'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM matched),'limit',page_limit,'offset',page_offset,
  'owner_options',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(person ORDER BY person->>'name') FROM(
   SELECT dation_private.team_person(target_workspace_id,id) person FROM owners ORDER BY id=selected_owner DESC NULLS LAST,id LIMIT 100) people),'[]'),
  'dda_options',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT domain) FROM decision_cases WHERE workspace_id=target_workspace_id),'[]')) INTO answer;
 RETURN answer;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.platform_home(target_workspace_id uuid, actor_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE member_role text; recent jsonb; attention jsonb; attention_total bigint;
BEGIN
 SELECT m.access_role INTO member_role
 FROM workspace_members m JOIN workspaces w ON w.id=m.workspace_id
 JOIN profiles p ON p.id=m.user_id
 JOIN auth.users u ON u.id=m.user_id AND u.email_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
 WHERE m.workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND m.user_id=actor_user_id
   AND m.status='active' AND w.status='active';
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Membership denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 PERFORM set_config('dation.workspace_id',target_workspace_id::text,true);

 -- Three recent, non-archived cases. Run summaries are read in this same snapshot;
 -- cached state alone must never determine an approval or the current version.
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'case',jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'status',c.status,'state_json',c.state_json,
     'orders_dataset_id',c.orders_dataset_id,'fleet_dataset_id',c.fleet_dataset_id,
     'last_activity_at',c.last_activity_at,'is_demo',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM datasets d WHERE d.workspace_id=c.workspace_id AND d.id IN(c.orders_dataset_id,c.fleet_dataset_id) AND d.is_sample)),
   'label',coalesce(nullif(c.label,''),nullif(o.label,''),o.canonical_filename,o.original_filename),
   'summaries',dation_private.decision_case_history(c.id,NULL,0,0)->'summaries'
 ) ORDER BY c.last_activity_at DESC,c.id DESC),'[]') INTO recent
 FROM (SELECT * FROM decision_cases WHERE workspace_id=target_workspace_id
   AND status IN('active','completed') ORDER BY last_activity_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 3) c
 JOIN datasets o ON o.id=c.orders_dataset_id AND o.workspace_id=target_workspace_id;

 attention='[]'; attention_total=0;
 -- Assigned reviewers see their work; admins retain an audited override.
 IF member_role IN('admin','operator') THEN
  WITH reviews AS (
   SELECT c.id AS case_id,c.last_activity_at,r.id AS run_id,r.node_id,'review'::text AS kind
   FROM decision_cases c
   CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('logistics_assignment'::text),('logistics_scheduling')) n(node_id)
   JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id,node_id,status,approved_at,superseded_at,upstream_run_id
     FROM decision_runs WHERE workspace_id=target_workspace_id
       AND decision_case_id=c.id AND node_id=n.node_id
     ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1) r ON true
   WHERE c.workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND c.status='active'
     AND r.status='completed' AND r.approved_at IS NULL AND r.superseded_at IS NULL
     AND (member_role='admin' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decision_assignments a WHERE a.workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND a.decision_case_id=c.id AND a.node_id=r.node_id AND a.approver_user_id IS NOT NULL AND a.approver_user_id<>actor_user_id))
     AND (r.node_id='logistics_assignment' OR EXISTS(
       SELECT 1 FROM decision_runs source WHERE source.id=r.upstream_run_id
         AND source.workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND source.decision_case_id=c.id
         AND source.node_id='logistics_assignment' AND source.status='completed'
         AND source.approved_at IS NOT NULL AND source.superseded_at IS NULL))
  ), handoffs AS (
   SELECT c.id AS case_id,c.last_activity_at,NULL::uuid AS run_id,'logistics_scheduling'::text AS node_id,'handoff'::text AS kind
   FROM decision_cases c JOIN decision_assignments a ON a.workspace_id=c.workspace_id AND a.decision_case_id=c.id
    AND a.node_id='logistics_scheduling' AND a.owner_user_id=actor_user_id
   JOIN decision_runs source ON source.workspace_id=c.workspace_id AND source.decision_case_id=c.id AND source.node_id='logistics_assignment'
    AND source.status='completed' AND source.approved_at IS NOT NULL AND source.superseded_at IS NULL
   WHERE c.workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND c.status='active'
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decision_runs r WHERE r.workspace_id=c.workspace_id AND r.decision_case_id=c.id AND r.node_id='logistics_scheduling'
     AND r.upstream_run_id=source.id AND r.superseded_at IS NULL AND r.status IN('queued','running','completed'))
  ), work AS (SELECT * FROM reviews UNION ALL SELECT * FROM handoffs), candidates AS (
   SELECT work.*,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decision_cases c JOIN datasets d ON d.workspace_id=c.workspace_id AND d.id IN(c.orders_dataset_id,c.fleet_dataset_id) WHERE c.workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND c.id=work.case_id AND d.is_sample) AS is_demo,count(*) OVER() AS total FROM work ORDER BY last_activity_at DESC,case_id DESC,node_id LIMIT 5
  ) SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(candidates)-'total'
      ORDER BY last_activity_at DESC,case_id DESC,node_id),'[]'),coalesce(max(total),0)
    INTO attention,attention_total FROM candidates;
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('recent_cases',recent,
   'attention',jsonb_build_object('items',attention,'total',attention_total));
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.platform_team(target_workspace_id uuid, actor_user_id uuid, search_text text DEFAULT ''::text, page_limit integer DEFAULT 25, page_offset integer DEFAULT 0, candidates_only boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE role_name text; members jsonb; invitations jsonb; total bigint;
BEGIN
 role_name=dation_private.team_actor(target_workspace_id,actor_user_id);
 IF length(search_text)>120 OR page_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 50 OR page_offset NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid page' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 WITH matched AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT m.*,u.email,coalesce(nullif(p.display_name,''),'Miembro del equipo') AS name
 FROM workspace_members m JOIN auth.users u ON u.id=m.user_id LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.id=m.user_id
 WHERE m.workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND (NOT candidates_only OR (m.status='active' AND m.access_role IN('admin','operator') AND u.email_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL))
 AND (search_text='' OR strpos(lower(concat_ws(' ',p.display_name,u.email)),lower(search_text))>0)),
 page AS (SELECT * FROM matched ORDER BY name,user_id LIMIT page_limit OFFSET page_offset)
 SELECT coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(page) ORDER BY name,user_id) FROM page),'[]'),(SELECT count(*) FROM matched) INTO members,total;
 invitations='[]';
 IF role_name='admin' AND NOT candidates_only THEN
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i) ORDER BY i.created_at DESC,i.id DESC),'[]') INTO invitations
 FROM (SELECT id,email,access_role,business_role,CASE WHEN expires_at<=now() THEN 'expired' ELSE status END AS status,expires_at,created_at,updated_at
 FROM workspace_invitations WHERE workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND status='pending'
 AND (search_text='' OR strpos(email,lower(search_text))>0) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT page_limit OFFSET page_offset) i;
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('members',members,'invitations',invitations,'total',total,'invitation_total',
 CASE WHEN role_name='admin' AND NOT candidates_only THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM workspace_invitations WHERE workspace_id=target_workspace_id AND status='pending' AND (search_text='' OR strpos(email,lower(search_text))>0)) ELSE 0 END,
 'limit',page_limit,'offset',page_offset);
END; $function$

constraints.name: authenticated_approval_actor
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((approved_by IS NULL) AND (approved_by_user_id IS NULL)) OR ((approved_by = 'shared_workspace:dation'::text) AND (approved_by_user_id IS NULL)) OR ((approved_by_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_by = ('user:'::text || (approved_by_user_id)::text)))))

constraints.name: decision_runs_approved_by_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((approved_by IS NULL) OR ((approved_at IS NOT NULL) AND ((approved_by = 'shared_workspace:dation'::text) OR (approved_by ~ '^user:[0-9a-f-]{36}$'::text)))))

constraints.name: decision_runs_case_node_pair_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((decision_case_id IS NULL) AND (node_id IS NULL)) OR ((decision_case_id IS NOT NULL) AND (node_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: decision_runs_dataset_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (dataset_id) REFERENCES datasets(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: decision_runs_decision_case_id_fkey

constraints.name: decision_runs_superseded_by_run_id_fkey

constraints.name: decision_runs_superseded_requires_approval_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((superseded_at IS NULL) OR (approved_at IS NOT NULL) OR (superseded_by_run_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: decision_runs_upstream_run_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (upstream_run_id) REFERENCES decision_runs(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: dispatch_job_lease_pair
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((state = 'running'::text) AND (lease_token IS NOT NULL) AND (lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((state <> 'running'::text) AND (lease_token IS NULL) AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL))))

constraints.name: dispatch_run_jobs_run_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES decision_runs(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: tenant_dispatch_run_jobs_run_id
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, run_id) REFERENCES decision_runs(workspace_id, id)

constraints.name: profiles_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: workspace_invitations_email_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((email = lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM email))) AND ((length(email) >= 3) AND (length(email) <= 254)) AND (email ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+[.][^[:space:]@]+$'::text)))

constraints.name: workspaces_name_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM name)) >= 2) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM name)) <= 120)))
